artworks.title: Roman Statue of a Standing Woman
artworks.medium: red chalk with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 21.3 x 14.3 cm (8 3/8 x 5 5/8 in.)
support: 22.9 x 16.6 cm (9 x 6 9/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a draped figure. The image depicts a standing figure wrapped in flowing garments. The drapery is detailed, emphasizing folds and shadows. The background is left bare, bringing focus to the figure. The sketch appears to be rendered with a light, monotone wash. The attention to the contour lines and shading highlights the three-dimensional quality of the figure.

artworks.title: Louis XIII, King of France
artworks.artist: Jacob Louis after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict
artworks.description: The image displays an engraving portraying a man from the shoulders up, facing slightly left. He has a round face with a goatee and mustache, dark curly hair falling above his shoulders. He wears ornate attire with a large ruffled lace collar. The man is surrounded by an oval frame decorated with foliage, fruits, and vines. Cherubic figures are at the frame's base, with elaborate carvings and scrollwork in the background. A text panel below the portrait contains Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: L'Ile aux Moines with Figure and Cart
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.dimensions: sight size: 22.5 x 39.5 cm (8 7/8 x 15 9/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon. On the horizon are faint lines suggesting buildings. On the right, a detailed pencil drawing features a person guiding two oxen pulling a cart. The background transitions from dense foliage to less distinct as it moves left. The drawing's fine pencil strokes capture details clearly, and the monochrome palette highlights shading and line work for a serene setting.

artworks.title: Coastal Landscape with Shipping
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.dimensions: sight size: 21.4 x 39.4 cm (8 7/16 x 15 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape from an elevated point of view. The horizon is positioned slightly above the center line of the image, with several ships on calm waters. A detailed ship stands slightly off-center to the right. In the distance, the shore with buildings or a settlement is visible. The sky has soft pencil strokes indicating clouds. The drawing is monochromatic, using shades of grey for depth. Light shading and fine lines depict water movement and ship structures with delicacy and precision.

artworks.title: Coastal Landscape with Shipping; Windmill in Distance
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a coastal scene. The horizon is slightly below the middle of the image, where the sea meets the land. Several sailing ships float in the distance. The shoreline slopes gently, leading to a hill with a windmill on top. There is a sparse line of trees further back on the hills. The brushstrokes are soft and detailed, capturing fine lines and shades. The colors are monochromatic, mostly gray. The sky is clear, emphasizing the simplicity of the landscape.

artworks.title: L'Ile aux Moines with Workers in a Field
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.dimensions: sight size: 22.5 x 43 cm (8 7/8 x 16 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene from an elevated point of view, overlooking a gently sloping landscape. Towards the top third of the composition, a horizon with buildings and a church spire is visible. In the distance, the land meets a body of water with faint outlines of hills. The drawing consists of fine pencil strokes showing texture and shading. The color palette is primarily monochrome with shades of gray on a beige paper background. In the foreground, a farmer guides oxen across a field with other figures engaged in farming tasks. Further away, additional figures and a cart pulled by a horse are visible in a landscape depicted with sweeping lines under a lightly clouded sky.

artworks.title: Landscape with Trees, Cottage, and Farm Wagon
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image is a monochromatic drawing showing a rustic scene with a thatched-roof building on the left and a large gnarled tree on the right. The horizon line is low, marked by the elongated shape of the structure, which stretches horizontally across the left side. Trees and foliage fill the upper portion of the scene with intricate, organic lines. The drawing style features loose, textured pencil strokes that suggest detail without rigid precision, adding a sense of movement and naturalism. The color palette consists solely of shades of gray and black. On the left, a wagon and indistinct shapes suggest human presence or use, while large trees and shadowed areas on the right create depth and emphasize the rural setting. The background fades into less defined forms, leaving a sense of openness and continuity with the countryside beyond.

artworks.title: River Landscape with Buildings, Boats, and Figures
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.dimensions: sight size: 24 x 40 cm (9 7/16 x 15 3/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This image is a pencil sketch of a rustic scene with tall trees obscuring the horizon. The central focus is on buildings and sheds with pitched roofs. The sketchy style of the drawing uses cross-hatching for texture, with sparse vegetation and a water feature in the foreground. The pencil medium creates a monochrome color palette, giving the scene a tranquil feel.

artworks.title: Cover for "Au pied du Sinaï"
artworks.medium: color lithograph on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert M. Walker
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a mountain, a figure standing on its summit, and a golden sky. The view is from an elevated position overlooking the scene, which includes a mountain range defining the horizon, a prominent sun, and various elements on the foreground like ruins. The brushstrokes convey a sense of rugged texture and flowing lines in the terrain, with a color palette of earth tones mixed with golden hues.

artworks.title: Selbstbildnis (Self-Portrait) from Deutsche Graphiker der Gegenwart (German Printmakers of Our Time)
artworks.medium: lithograph from a bound volume with 15 lithographs, eight woodcuts, eight photomechanical reproductions, and one drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert M. Walker
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a person's head and shoulders. The subject faces forward with a slight turn of the head to the side. The facial features are drawn with bold, dark strokes to emphasize contours, shadows, and structure. The person wears a wide-brimmed hat, and their hair is roughly textured. Minimal strokes suggest clothing around the shoulders. Signatures and inscriptions, including a date of "30 April 1920," are on the right. The background is blank.

artworks.title: Selbstbildnis (Self-Portrait) from Deutsche Graphiker der Gegenwart (German Printmakers of Our Time)
artworks.medium: lithograph from a bound volume with 15 lithographs, eight woodcuts, eight photomechanical reproductions, and one drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert M. Walker
artworks.description: The image is an artistic drawing of a man shown in a three-quarter view portrait from his shoulders up. The man has his head tilted downward and is wearing a hat, a jacket with a notched lapel, and a collared shirt. His facial features are sketched with deep shadows under his eyes and lines around his mouth, giving the impression of a mustache. The background is simple with rough shading behind the man to the left.

artworks.title: Ziegen (Goats) from Deutsche Graphiker der Gegenwart (German Printmakers of Our Time)
artworks.medium: lithograph from a bound volume with 15 lithographs, eight woodcuts, eight photomechanical reproductions, and one drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert M. Walker
artworks.description: The image shows a group of goats on a narrow, rocky pathway along a steep cliff edge. The perspective is slightly above eye level, looking down onto the path. Closest to us, a goat stands prominently, gazing forward, surrounded by others in a curved line along the cliff. In the distance to the right, more goats traverse the ridge against a sky with strokes indicating clouds. The horizon is high on the right, showing the steep terrain drop. The drawing style has sketchy brushstrokes with a monochrome palette of blacks and greys on off-white paper, emphasizing fur texture and landscape ruggedness. Sparse vegetation grows on the rocks, adding to the wild setting.

artworks.title: Die Boxer (The Boxers) from Deutsche Graphiker der Gegenwart (German Printmakers of Our Time)
artworks.medium: lithograph from a bound volume with 15 lithographs, eight woodcuts, eight photomechanical reproductions, and one drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert M. Walker
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four exaggerated figures in dynamic poses. The figures are muscular and nude, some holding what seem to be boxing gloves. The background includes sketchy outlines of a tree. The drawing uses bold lines and minimal shading.

artworks.title: Riesenblattlaus (Giant Aphid) from Deutsche Graphiker der Gegenwart (German Printmakers of Our Time)
artworks.medium: lithograph from a bound volume with 15 lithographs, eight woodcuts, eight photomechanical reproductions, and one drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert M. Walker
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of intricate, intersecting lines and angular shapes and some curling and spiraling forms, giving it an abstract appearance. The elements are reminiscent of plant stems and leaves. Some parts resemble flowers or branches stretching from the main stalk. The composition has a rhythmic flow, suggesting the structure of a stylized vine or organic growth on a plain background. The abstract nature invites the viewer to interpret the shapes in diverse ways.

artworks.title: Gruppe im Sturm (Couple in a Storm) from Deutsche Graphiker der Gegenwart (German Printmakers of Our Time)
artworks.medium: woodcut from a bound volume with 15 lithographs, eight woodcuts, eight photomechanical reproductions, and one drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert M. Walker
artworks.description: The image is a monochromatic illustration showing two figures. The larger figure is kneeling and bending over the smaller figure. The larger figure has a beard, wears a hat with a wide brim, and is clothed in flowing drapery. The smaller figure is laying on the ground with limbs drawn in close and wrapped in a cloth covering most of their body. The lines throughout the image are bold and dynamic, with a background of wavy lines.

artworks.title: Badende (Bathers) from Deutsche Graphiker der Gegenwart (German Printmakers of Our Time)
artworks.medium: lithograph from a bound volume with 15 lithographs, eight woodcuts, eight photomechanical reproductions, and one drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert M. Walker
artworks.description: In this abstract image, black lines and angular shapes form two figures facing each other. The strokes create a sense of movement, with some lines suggesting limbs and others indicating the background. The composition depicts a scene that may suggest conversation or contemplation, with shapes resembling heads and shoulders leaning towards each other.

artworks.title: Löwe (Lion) from Deutsche Graphiker der Gegenwart (German Printmakers of Our Time)
artworks.medium: lithograph from a bound volume with 15 lithographs, eight woodcuts, eight photomechanical reproductions, and one drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert M. Walker
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dog. The drawing features a dog rendered in bold, rough strokes of black on a plain background. The dog's form is conveyed through minimal, energetic lines that suggest structure and movement. The use of shadow and shape is minimal yet effective, emphasizing the dog's facial features and limbs, giving it a sense of depth and presence despite the simplicity of the execution.

artworks.title: The Triumphal Chariot of Maximilian I (The Great Triumphal Car) [plate 1 of 8]
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Harold P. Morris
artworks.description: This image features a detailed allegorical scene. The drawing includes mythological figures, elaborate fabrics, classical attire, banners with words like "Iusticia," "Clementia," and "Veritas," a regal eagle on an emblem with heraldic symbols and Latin inscriptions like "MAGNIFICENTIA," decorative swirls, florals, and fantastical creatures such as a lion. The composition aims to create a harmonious balance between these elements, possibly representing virtues or qualities related to justice and truth.

artworks.title: The Triumphal Chariot of Maximilian I (The Great Triumphal Car) [plate 2 of 8]
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Harold P. Morris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chariot with symbols of virtues. It features a detailed and ornate chariot driven by representations of virtues such as "Fortitudo" (Fortitude), "Intelligentia" (Intelligence), "Constantia" (Constancy), and "Prudentia" (Prudence). The chariot is adorned with intricate engravings, symbols, and faces. Reins lead to guides labeled with other virtues like "Mobilitas" (Mobility) and "Potentia" (Power). The wheels display emblems, and detailed linework conveys a sense of motion and power.

artworks.title: The Triumphal Chariot of Maximilian I (The Great Triumphal Car) [plate 3 of 8]
artworks.medium: woodcut with letterpress text on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Harold P. Morris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene involving a horse-drawn chariot. The illustration features a horse decorated with elaborate armor or embellishments, pulling a chariot. A partially clad figure is holding onto the horse's bridle, guiding it forward. Above the scene, the terms "Providentia" and "Moderatio" are inscribed. The detailed drawing uses fine lines and intricate detailing to convey texture and form, characteristic of Renaissance-era engravings. The thicket of lines creates a robust and textured appearance that exudes a sense of movement and vitality. The text at the top is written in Latin.

artworks.title: The Triumphal Chariot of Maximilian I (The Great Triumphal Car) [plate 4 of 8]
artworks.medium: woodcut with letterpress text on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Harold P. Morris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals in classical attire guiding horses. The foreground features two armored horses being led by figures dressed in draped garments typical of classical antiquity. The intricate line work highlights the ornate detailing on the harnesses and garments. Above the horses, the words "ALACRITAS" and "OPORTUNITAS" are labeled. The drawing includes text in a formal script at the top of the image. The line work is delicate, conveying a high level of craftsmanship likely intended to convey allegorical themes.

artworks.title: The Triumphal Chariot of Maximilian I (The Great Triumphal Car) [plate 5 of 8]
artworks.medium: woodcut with letterpress text on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Harold P. Morris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chariot being pulled by two horses. The linework depicts a scene with classical motifs. Two horses are in motion, adorned with ornate harnesses. The horses are pulling a chariot, not fully visible. Above the horses are decorative curls and Latin texts labeling different aspects, such as "Fortitudo" (Strength) and "Velocitas" (Swiftness). The art style is reminiscent of Albrecht Dürer's woodcuts and engravings, emphasizing fine linework and classical allegories.

artworks.title: The Triumphal Chariot of Maximilian I (The Great Triumphal Car) [plate 6 of 8]
artworks.medium: woodcut with letterpress text on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Harold P. Morris
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a chariot scene with classical figures and horses. Two figures are guiding a decorated chariot pulled by two ornate horses. Latin text is above the scene, along with decorative scrollwork labeling the figures as "Acrimonia" and "Virilitas." The drawing is highly detailed with a classical style highlighting the elegance of the horses and the dynamic poses of their guides. The horses are adorned with armor-like coverings and intricate patterns, while the figures wear flowing garments reminiscent of classical Greco-Roman styles. The use of lines and shading provides texture and depth to the scene.
